items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Yeah...he was the one-man band on Canal Street...

ctx.x: Yeah...he was the one-man band on Canal Street... That's what I thought... Played kazoot...and...tribe drums...and...gitarl...all at one time...he was the one-man band...
I saw him when I was down there...I think in the Navy in 1945...I used to see him there...
